PlugInPackageMetaData.Author: Hamied Nabizada
PlugInPackageMetaData.Description: Export editor views as SVG, PDF or PNG that look exactly like the editor, for papers and slides. Shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+E complete tree, Ctrl+Shift+K tree to clipboard, Ctrl+Shift+W whole window, Ctrl+Shift+R drag a region. Options in the SvgExport panel.
